name: vibesdk-sandbox-orchestrator-lambda
description: API Gateway HTTP API (v2) Lambda implementing aws/sandbox-contract's SandboxServiceClient by driving ECS RunTask/DescribeTasks/StopTask against aws/infra/sandbox's Fargate cluster, tracking instanceId -> task mapping in the vibesdk-sandbox-instances DynamoDB table, and proxying per-instance calls to the right container's aws/sandbox-controlplane server. Not part of the main vibesdk build.

scripts.package: npm run build && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'module'}))" && cd dist && zip -r ../sandbox-orchestrator-lambda.zip handler.js reaper.js package.json
